summary: Iter 68 — BroadcastFeed cinematic command-center overlay E2E. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass on POST /api/ops/outbound/live-pulse `broadcast_events` (key present, ≤25 cap, required fields ts/kind/lane/summary/ref/simulated, valid lanes outreach/reply/demo/hot/deal/scheduling/intake/engine, summaries human-readable, sorted newest-first, simulated=bool, auth gating). Frontend: every spec'd testid renders correctly — broadcast-feed-control-rail, broadcast-feed-toggle (text 'Broadcast Live' enabled / 'Broadcast Off' disabled, cyan pulsing dot), broadcast-feed-mute, broadcast-feed (data-active toggles true/false), broadcast-feed-active (data-lane=deal observed), broadcast-feed-dismiss (immediately removes current event → data-active=false). Toggle persistence verified: localStorage `cb_broadcast_feed_v1:enabled` flips between '0' and '1' on click. Pause-on-hover wiring confirmed: inner .pointer-events-auto element exists with onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave handlers in source. Control rail visible across Performance/Leads/Outbound tabs. LiveSendPulse regression on Outbound tab: outbound-live-pulse renders alongside BroadcastFeed without conflict (screenshot confirms both visible simultaneously with sandbox-mode banner and ticker showing live deal event).

console_warnings.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop. Check the render method of LeadsTab.' Pre-existing, unrelated to BroadcastFeed iter — but worth fixing.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Fix the pre-existing 'unique key prop' React warning in LeadsTab (unrelated to BroadcastFeed; surfaced during nav test).
PLATFORM (no code change) — RESEND_API_KEY remains unbound in production runtime → mode='sandbox' as expected per Iter 67. Awaiting Emergent Support.
critical_code_review_comments: BroadcastFeed.jsx (~327 lines) is well-scoped: persisted seen-event hashes via localStorage prevent duplicate replays on refresh; aliveRef + clearTimeout cleanup on unmount; pause-on-hover via hoverRef short-circuits the auto-fade timer. Good defensive pattern.
outbound.py `_broadcast_recent` aggregator (lines 3006-3067) cleanly merges 8 event types into single normalized stream with consistent shape — easy to extend to new event types.

Both LiveSendPulse (4s poll) and BroadcastFeed (6s poll) hit the same POST /api/ops/outbound/live-pulse endpoint. No conflict observed but consider response caching/dedup at API layer if more pollers are added in future iterations.

Toggle text rendering: source says 'Broadcast Live' / 'Broadcast Off' (capitalized) but className `uppercase` causes visual 'BROADCAST LIVE' / 'BROADCAST OFF'. Spec said uppercase — this is a CSS-only rendering, textContent in tests returns capitalized. Working as intended; just noted for any future testid/text-based assertions.
